digest.component_or_area: MCP error handling and CLI/library interface alignment
propositions: MCP tool failures currently surface as unstructured prose in exceptions or ad-hoc partial shapes, whereas the CLI emits a structured error_envelope with a machine code discriminator
A single error_code_for(exc) classifier and KNOWN_ERROR_CODES vocabulary must be defined in the library layer to enable code-consistent emission across CLI, MCP, and library interfaces

MCP failures (both exception-raised via a tool guard wrapping McpEnvelopeError and soft-error returns from explain_criterion and LLM tools) must carry an error code from the shared vocabulary while preserving existing agent-branching signal fields
TicketNotFoundError must be a distinct ReadError subclass raised only at genuine not-found sites so that error_code_for classifies by isinstance rather than fragile message substring matching
The error_envelope schema must relax input from required to optional to accommodate MCP failures without a target being resolved, while CLI envelopes remain unchanged
Cross-interface tests must verify that the same failure (missing ticket, concurrency mismatch) emits an identical error code from the library classifier, CLI envelope, and MCP envelope
